389:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm no magical surprise box with a glamorous beauty like her tucked inside.」

389:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's how it is, $n. Please don't have any indecent fantasies about me.」

389:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... Please spare me any punishment with $$ブーストアップ$$...!」

389:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I'm glad for you, $$メール$$. $$ランド$$ and $$ガンレオン$$ managed to break through their wall.」

389:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a gift for all the hard work you've done supporting him, please accept this.」

389:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. With these, even you should be able to compete with $$エルーナルーナ$$.」

389:t_10:29.en:
$$メール$$
「I get it! I pop them right in front of her, then attack while she's startled!」

389:t_10:31.en:
$$メール$$
「I'll attach them to $$ガンレオン$$ right away. Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$!」

389:t_10:33.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh, sorry! I forgot something important!」

389:t_10:34.en:
$$メール$$
「Let's give it our all today!」

389:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I won't allow you to make her cry, $$ランド$$...」

390:t_000:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, are you ready!? Our opponent is $$ストラウス$$, Supreme Commander of the Imperial Army!」

390:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we defeat him here, $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ will gain tremendous momentum!」

390:t_000:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're really fired up, Captain $$オットー$$.」

390:t_000:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Yes... He's like a different person.」

390:t_000:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$, do you have any idea why the captain's changed?」

390:t_000:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「None at all! The captain is his usual self!」

390:t_000:7.en:
$$メール$$
「How about you, Darling? Did $$クロウ$$'s training change anything?」

390:t_000:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, yeah... I certainly got plenty of stress.」

390:t_000:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「A-are you all right? Even your face looks different.」

390:t_000:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No risk, no return... Getting somewhere isn't easy.」

390:t_000:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The million-G man sure has a way with words.」

390:t_000:12.en:
$$青山$$
「Indeed. Those words are worth a million G.」

390:t_000:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「...I'm gonna hold this against you, $$クロウ$$.」

390:t_000:17.en:
$$シン$$
「Still, if even $$ランド$$ can't smile, that training must have been brutal.」

390:t_000:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「Why don't you try it too, $$シン$$?」

390:t_000:19.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Please don't, $$キラ$$! $$シン$$'s scowl looks so vicious it isn't even funny!」

390:t_000:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Perfect. He can fill the vacancy in the Quiet Five.」

390:t_000:21.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Yes. If $$アマタ$$ took that training too, his face might look a little more serious.」

390:t_000:22.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Ha ha, ha ha... I'll pass.」

390:t_000:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Youth's a wonderful thing. They can relax even in a crisis like this.」

390:t_000:24.en:
$$メール$$
「You're sounding like an old man, Darling.」

390:t_001:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It seems something flipped a switch in him.」

390:t_001:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do this, $$メール$$! It's too soon for me to join that crowd!」

390:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Push him, and he pushes back... That's a man who's made it through $$ミッション・スプリング$$ for you.」

390:t_001:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「This is no time to fool around! Here they come!」

390:t_002:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What on earth is he doing that for!?」

390:t_002:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Somehow, people in masks come full circle and end up desperate to show themselves off.」

390:t_002:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「So that's... his declaration of war before the battle!?」

390:t_002:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「I like it! You're ready to do this too, huh!?」

390:t_002:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I doubt this has anything to do with their $$スフィア$$s being compatible.」

390:t_002:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So that armored bastard's a hot-blooded idiot with muscles for brains, just like $$ランド$$!」

390:t_002:13.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「There's the $$ヒートスマイル$$ I've been waiting for!」

390:t_002:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So these two belong to that crowd too...」

390:t_002:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ストラウス$$! I've received your declaration of war!」

390:t_002:18.en:
$$オットー$$
「Honestly! That man has fallen for the enemy's provocation!」

390:t_002:19.en:
$$レイアム$$
「What shall we do, Captain?」

390:t_002:20.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll accept the challenge, of course! If they're coming head-on, clumsy tricks will be useless!」

390:t_002:21.en:
$$レイアム$$
(Was it his break? The captain seems to have found quite a lot of courage...)

390:t_002:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「The enemy wants a fleet battle! Get in close and destroy them one by one!」

390:t_002:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Come on, $$ストラウス$$! If you're coming at us with brute force, I'll beat you down with brute force!!」

390:t_003:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Well played, Supreme Commander...! Those orders are precise!」

390:t_003:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy is concentrating its attacks on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$!」

390:t_003:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「I can see that for myself...!」
